items.title: Remote Desktop Services Failures on Windows Servers Following September Update
items.description: Windows administrators worldwide are grappling with a disruptive Remote Desktop Services (RDS) bug that surfaced immediately after Microsoft shipped its September 2026 Patch Tuesday cumulative updates. Session hosts running Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 have begun freezing hours after boot, leaving RDP connections stuck at “Connecting…” and preventing logged-in users from disconnecting or…

items.title: Skullcandy Dime 3 Bluetooth Flaw Lets Nearby Attackers Hijack Audio and Spy Through Microphone
items.description: A security vulnerability in Skullcandy Dime 3 wireless earbuds could allow nearby attackers to pair with the device without the owner’s approval, hijack audio playback, and potentially capture live microphone audio. Tracked as Vulnerability Note VU#859658, the issue affects Skullcandy Dime 3 earbuds (model S2DCW) running firmware version 1.0.0.28. The flaw was publicly disclosed on […] The post…

items.title: Hackers Use Claude AI Agents to Automate Cyberattacks, Develop 0-Days and Evade Detection
items.description: Anthropic’s Threat Intelligence team has disclosed a sweeping new report detailing how state-sponsored espionage groups, financially motivated cybercriminals, and lone hacktivists weaponized its Claude AI models to automate entire cyberattack chains, generate zero-day exploits, and dynamically rewrite malware to slip past security defenses. items.title: Indonesia Hit by Android Banking App-Cloning Campaign
items.description: The GoldFactory threat group exploits the Android Work Profile feature to deliver the Gigabud Trojan, while Mantax Otax spreads separately.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-29386: Cesanta
items.description: A CVSS score 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Charbel (dwbruijn)' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-09-10, 1 days ago. The vendor is given until 2027-01-08 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
